human_goal: The user should not have to remember the plan, choose unique worker prompts, track which chats ran, copy results, design every next batch, or keep this parent conversation alive. Fresh parents and workers recover from durable state; many identical workers can eventually claim useful distinct work automatically across Prometeo, Facultad, Alumnos and future roots.

must_preserve: Human is not scheduler, collector, result courier, context bus, durable memory, or manual worker allocator in the target system.
Bound parent `.` must act from durable state and persist changed frontier before replying.
Conversation/model is disposable compute; durable state is sufficient for recovery.
Jobs/opportunities exist before substantive work; claim/STARTED/RETURN/DONE are externally observable durable evidence.
Atomic claims prevent identical generic workers from doing the same substantive work.
Workers may propose future work and safely continue after RETURN, but proposals are candidates and workers do not self-promote authority.
Planner/Compiler is continuous metabolism, not a one-time plan document.
Multiple project roots share substrate but keep project-specific identity, context, privacy and authority.
Live is passive telemetry only; correctness never depends on the screen.
Use abundant chats aggressively only when expected durable value exceeds coordination/integration cost.
Current/Human Accepted/Served remain distinct from worker completion or candidate recommendations.
negative_knowledge: Do not spend current frontier on Prometeo Live cosmetics.
Do not ask the user to design the next numbered worker batch if Planner/Compiler can derive it.
Do not interpret 20 available chats as a requirement to keep 20 busy with redundant work.
Do not literally clone the parent transcript; create durable project/root Chat Objects sharing the control substrate.
Do not advertise `/w` generic workers until queue/claim collision canaries pass.
Do not wait idle for WI-BIG-09 or WI-BIG-13 while completed returns can already be converged.
Do not let a worker continue into shared-authority mutation merely because it still has context; post-return continuation remains scoped and safe.
